jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(A) inventory: the Caledonia Cooperative School District, a unified union district in the Caledonia Central Supervisory Union (member towns Barnet, Walden, Waterford).
Caledonia Central Supervisory Union (official site hosting the district's pages).

sources.note: Caledonia Cooperative articles of agreement (study committee final report, 'Final Version for AOE', hosted on the Town of Barnet's official site), Article 8: 'The Unified District Board of Directors shall be composed of nine (9) individuals elected by Australian ballot by the voters of the municipalities in which they reside' -- three directors per member town (Barnet, Walden, Waterford), elected by that town's voters only, with weighted board votes for proportionality (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(1) pattern); Article 9 sets three-year terms.
Caledonia Cooperative School District board page (Caledonia Central SU, official): the nine current directors by town with term expirations; all nine also appear in the June 8, 2026 board minutes.

Caledonia Cooperative board minutes, April 11, 2024 (APPROVED; the reorganization meeting nine days after the April 2, 2024 annual meeting): Bobbie Roy sits as a Barnet director -- she seconds the chair nomination and nominates the vice-chair and the clerk -- and no appointment to her seat is recorded, in a district whose minutes do record appointments (cf. Marciel Greene, May 11, 2026). The 2024 Annual Report's warning (Article 2) warned a Barnet director for a three-year term at that meeting. Supt. Matt Foster (CCSU) confirmed on 2026-10-26 that Roy is currently serving. DISCLOSURE: the certified April 2, 2024 vote totals are printed only in the district's 2024-25 Annual Report, whose sole web copy is unreachable (the district's legacy file handler returns 404 for every link and the Wayback Machine holds no snapshot), so the tally itself was not read firsthand; a delegated read of that report shows Roy's tally line asterisked, indicating a possible write-in win. Minted ELECTED on the convergent official record (warning + reorganization seating + successive official rosters + superintendent confirmation) under Walter's ruling of 2026-10-26.

Caledonia Cooperative board minutes, April 11, 2024 (APPROVED; the reorganization meeting nine days after the April 2, 2024 annual meeting): Daniel Gingue sits as a Waterford director and is elected the board's Vice-Chair, and no appointment to his seat is recorded, in a district whose minutes do record appointments (cf. Marciel Greene, May 11, 2026). The 2024 Annual Report shows his prior term expiring in 2024 and its warning (Article 5) warned a Waterford director for a three-year term at that meeting. Supt. Matt Foster (CCSU) confirmed on 2026-10-26 that Gingue is currently serving. DISCLOSURE: the certified April 2, 2024 vote totals are printed only in the district's 2024-25 Annual Report, whose sole web copy is unreachable (the district's legacy file handler returns 404 for every link and the Wayback Machine holds no snapshot), so the tally itself was not read firsthand; a delegated read of that report shows Gingue re-elected with counted votes. Minted ELECTED on the convergent official record (warning + reorganization seating + successive official rosters + superintendent confirmation) under Walter's ruling of 2026-10-26.
